dedupe_keys.name: powergama grid and market analysis model

description: PowerGAMA is an open-source Python package for power-grid and market analysis. Its developers publish the dispatch model, user guide and installation instructions. A user provides buses, generators, demand, transmission links, storage and time-series assumptions. The model solves sequential time steps with a storage-value method, producing generation, flows, storage use and nodal price patterns for the chosen network and period. Geography depends on the input case; the catalogue already has a separate 2014 European input dataset for this software. The package is free under MIT terms. A limitation stated by its README is that it omits start-up costs, ramp limits, forecast errors and unit commitment, and assumes a frictionless nodal market; it can overestimate renewable accommodation. PowerGAMA is useful for screening grid development and interconnection cases. The catalogue's data-powergama-europe-2014 is input data, not this general software. No European dataset was downloaded or model run.
inputs: Grid, generation, storage and demand time series
